name: Rat Ogre
author: Johan Markström
description: Rat Ogres are lethal but stupid killing machines, whose small brains are singularly devoted to the pursuit of fighting and tearing their enemies apart.

abilities.name: Stupidity
abilities.text: Unless activated within 3" of a visible friendly `HERO` or enemy fighter, roll a die. On a 1-4, this fighter makes a Wait action. On a 5+, this fighter may activate as normal.

abilities.name: Bounding Leaps
abilities.text: A fighter can only use this ability if there is a visible enemy fighter within 6" of them. This fighter makes a free move action and must finish closer to the closest visible enemy fighter than they were at the start of that move action.

abilities.name: Savage Mauling
abilities.text: This fighter makes a free melee attack action. Then, you may remove the target of that attack action from the battlefield, and place it back anywhere within 1" of this fighter.
